name: Remm Heating, Inc.
what_they_do: Heating, AC/ventilation, plumbing and drain-cleaning contractor serving residential, commercial and industrial accounts, with 24/7 emergency service, preventative maintenance plans and free estimates on major installations. Site pitches no-commission technicians and 84-month interest-free PSE&G financing.
customers: Homeowners plus commercial and industrial property accounts in North Brunswick and surrounding Middlesex County

size_signals.signal: Serves residential, commercial and industrial accounts with four service lines (heating, AC/ventilation, plumbing, drain cleaning)
Site runs an ongoing 'seeking employment' recruitment call - implies multiple technicians and hiring pressure
Offers PSE&G 84-month interest-free financing and maintenance plans, which usually requires a dealer relationship and steady volume

listing.reviews: count not shown in limited Maps view

website_review.primary_cta: 'CALL TODAY' / 'Don't Wait! Call Today!' with the phone number repeated in the header, hero and footer - no other conversion path
website_review.online_booking_or_quote: none - free estimates and emergency service are phone-only
website_review.trust_signals: No-commission technicians statement, financing offer, maintenance plans, 4.7 Google rating (not displayed on the site); no photos, no licence numbers, no review widget
website_review.out_of_date_signs: Very thin brochure site: no meta description, no schema markup, no hours, no photos, a single 'Don't Take A Beating!' slogan page; copyright is current (2026) and pages load
website_review.search_basics: Home title is just 'Remm Heating, Inc.' with no town or service keywords; separate /services/, /about/, /resources/ and /contact/ pages do exist but lack descriptive titles
top_issues: No contact form and no email anywhere - a visitor who will not phone has no way in
Business hours are nowhere on the site, despite advertising 24/7 emergency service
No LocalBusiness schema and no meta descriptions; four pages total, none targeting a specific service+town query

agent_readiness.notes: Findable: Google profile is present with HVAC contractor category, correct phone/address and published hours (closed, opens 8 AM), but it is bare - 'Add photos' prompt appears, so no photos and no owner posts. robots.txt is standard WordPress (only /wp-admin/ disallowed, crawl-delay 10), so AI crawlers are technically allowed. Answerable: hours are absent from the site, no price ranges, no service-area list, and zero JSON-LD blocks; only the four service names appear as text. Bookable: no form, no booking, no email - a customer's agent can only read a phone number.

operations_signals.signal: 24/7 emergency service promises 'call and speak to a live person', meaning staffed phones around the clock - the highest-cost intake in the trade
All quotes, maintenance-plan signups and drain-cleaning jobs go through the same phone number with no web intake
Actively recruiting technicians on the site - hiring strain often shows up as missed calls during peak season

top_opportunities.opportunity: Add a proper quote/booking form and an AI phone-or-chat intake that answers after hours and captures job details
top_opportunities.evidence: Contact page has zero forms and no email; the only channel is the phone despite 24/7 positioning

top_opportunities.opportunity: Rebuild the site's basics: service pages with town targets, hours as text, LocalBusiness schema, real job photos and a review widget
top_opportunities.evidence: Home title is only the company name, no meta description, no JSON-LD, no hours, no photos, four pages total

top_opportunities.opportunity: Automated maintenance-plan reminders and post-job review requests to grow the 4.7 rating
top_opportunities.evidence: They sell preventative maintenance plans and financing but have no digital follow-up visible anywhere

scores.reasons: Phone-only, four-page site with no schema or form is a large, easily-described gap; an HVAC/plumbing firm serving commercial accounts plus financing has budget; fixes are standard build work; observed directly.
